name: channel_model_default
description: channel_model with default parameters: only the resampler's 3 sample lead and length remain

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Defaults: resampler at phase 0 (a 1 in tap 3) and nothing else; both outputs are the input advanced by 3 samples and 8 samples shorter. Exact.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: The resampler's taps at phase 0 are a single 1 and zeros; the 1 saturates to 1 - 2^-15 in Q15 (|x| * 2^-15 <= 0.66 LSB) and the product is rounded (0.5 LSB). Measured 1.0 LSB.
